scope: Identity-locked camera-perturbation demos for three real-scene embodied task videos
summary: Three complete ten-second task videos and a ten-second reel now show the same robot, blue bottle, and real Ego kitchen scene under source, left/right oblique, and continuous orbit-style camera-frame perturbations. Identity lineage passes, while the result remains explicitly bounded to a 2-D projective proxy.
evidence: Handover, unscrew, rinse, and the sequential reel each decode to 1280x870, 240 frames, 24 FPS, and 10.000 seconds.

Every derived view is an explicit homography of the same decoded source frame in camera:source_pixels; no per-frame subject generation, cross-task subject compositing, or generated interpolation is used.

Across 24 sampled frames per task and all three derived views, the worst central-frame round-trip PSNR is 33.5567 dB, maximum MAE is 2.1828, and minimum bounded similarity is 0.99144; all three task identity-lineage gates pass.
A real local browser loaded all four viewpoint videos at readyState 4 with 1280x870 metadata, 10-second duration, no media errors, and no console warnings or errors.
The demo page presents the three-task reel, three complete per-task clips, dynamic manifest metrics, the generated identity-anchor board, and an explicit 2-D claim boundary.
lessons: When subject consistency is the top priority, derive all displayed camera perturbations from the same decoded frame and make that lineage explicit rather than asking a generative model to redraw every view.
Viewpoint evidence should separate bounded camera-frame robustness from learned novel-view synthesis and calibrated 3-D generalization.
limitations: The left/right and orbit views are image-plane projective proxies and do not reveal unseen surfaces.
This run does not establish physical multi-camera capture, calibrated 3-D reconstruction, contact physics, force, collision correctness, or physical robot execution.
The ImageGen anchor is a poster/reference artifact only and is not used as a frame source for the videos.
next_actions: Replace the projective proxy with synchronized calibrated multi-camera DROID or equivalent robot data before claiming learned viewpoint generalization.
Retain the same identity-lineage and browser media-load gates for future true novel-view candidates.
